us.h: Coastal storms threaten Thanksgiving travel, major Northeast storm possible
us.s: After Sunday's rain snarled Boston flights, forecasters expect a lull Monday, then storms in the Southeast and Pacific Northwest Tuesday and a potentially major Northeast storm on Thanksgiving Day.

us.h: Stock futures rebound after brutal AI-led selloff week
us.s: Futures jumped Monday after the S&P 500 closed Friday in correction territory and the Dow had its worst week since 2020; markets now price roughly 90% odds of a Fed rate hike Dec. 9.

us.h: Democrats lock in biggest House majority in decades
us.s: Democrats have won at least 258 House seats, a 44-seat gain that tops their 2018 wave, with four races still open including two Louisiana runoffs in December.

us.h: Delta system outage triggers Atlanta ground stop
us.s: A Sunday failure of Delta's weight-and-balance system briefly halted Atlanta-bound flights and reportedly delayed thousands of departures while crews calculated loads by hand.

us.h: Trump slams Schumer as Democrats weigh leadership change
us.s: Trump said working with a Majority Leader Schumer would be very hard, as Sen. Chris Van Hollen challenges Schumer ahead of a Dec. 1 secret-ballot caucus vote.

world.h: Trump says he may resume Iran strikes after New Year
world.s: Trump told Fox News he is inclined to order new strikes if no deal is reached, called Iran's negotiators stallers, and warned ships testing the US blockade would be sunk.

world.h: Tanker incident near US blockade line in Gulf of Oman
world.s: UK maritime authorities reported a tanker incident involving military forces near the US blockade line, as Iranian media said two supertankers caught fire after hitting mines east of Hormuz.

world.h: Gulf neighbors condemn Iranian strike on Bahrain
world.s: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they targeted US Patriot sites in Bahrain; Bahrain reported a fire at a civilian industrial site and two injured, drawing condemnation from Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Qatar.

world.h: Russian drones kill at least four near Kyiv
world.s: A drone partially collapsed a five-story building in Dymer and another hit a grocery store in Vyshneve; about 10 people may remain trapped under rubble.

world.h: RSF drone attacks kill four around Khartoum, hit UN building
world.s: Overnight drone strikes blamed on Sudan's paramilitary RSF killed four people, including a child, and damaged a UN building while staff were inside.

world.h: Suspected drone strikes Russian vessel at Libyan port
world.s: A suspected sea drone hit a Russian ship refueling at Benghazi's naval base, a day after a Russian cargo ship was struck in the Baltic in an attack Finland attributed to Ukraine.

tech.h: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $43.9B all-stock deal
tech.s: Zscaler holders get 1.135 CrowdStrike shares each, a 34% premium; CrowdStrike shares fell premarket while Zscaler jumped. Closing is expected in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028.

tech.h: Trump urges Nvidia board to rehire Jensen Huang
tech.s: Trump posted that he hopes Nvidia brings Huang back, a reversal from earlier calls for outside leadership; Huang still faces congressional interviews over the China chip and spy-affair scrutiny.

tech.h: Tesla begins rolling out FSD v15 with AI 'Reality View'
tech.s: Early-access owners are getting FSD v15, which adds a real-time AI-generated view of surroundings; Musk says a wide release comes with December's holiday update.

tech.h: BepiColombo probe enters orbit around Mercury
tech.s: The joint European-Japanese spacecraft reached Mercury orbit after an eight-year trip; its two orbiters separate in December and science work begins in April 2027.

talking.h: Will wind ground the 100th Macy's parade balloons?
talking.s: Forecasters expect 1-2 inches of rain and gusty winds in NYC on Thanksgiving, though the worst may arrive after the parade; high winds could force balloons to stay down.

talking.h: College football chaos reshuffles AP Top 25
talking.s: UCLA fell 18-16 in triple overtime at Michigan and Indiana lost in overtime at Washington; Georgia and Utah lead the new poll, with Texas climbing into the top five.
Dak Prescott threw four touchdowns and ran for another as Dallas scored on its first six drives in a 51-30 win, its first 50-point game since 2022.

coming.s: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is due Wednesday, a key input ahead of the Dec. 8-9 rate meeting.
Markets, banks, government offices and the post office close; the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade steps off in New York.

coming.h: Lions host Bears in Thanksgiving showdown
coming.s: Two 8-2 teams meet in Detroit at 1 p.m. ET on FOX.

coming.h: Black Friday; stocks trade a half day
coming.s: U.S. stock markets close early the day after Thanksgiving.
The rivalry game kicks off at noon in Columbus, with Ohio State reeling after a loss at Nebraska.
The online shopping counterpart to Black Friday closes out the holiday weekend.
